title: 2007 AMC 10B Problem 15
statement: The angles of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) satisfy \(\angle A = 2\angle B = 3\angle C = 4\angle D.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle A,\) rounded to the nearest whole number?

solutions.text:
Let \(x=\angle A.\) Then \(\angle B=\dfrac{x}{2},\) \(\angle C=\dfrac{x}{3},\) and \(\angle D=\dfrac{x}{4}.\)

The angles sum to \(360^\circ,\) so \(x+\dfrac{x}{2}+\dfrac{x}{3}+\dfrac{x}{4}=\dfrac{25x}{12}=360.\)

Thus \(x=\dfrac{12\cdot 360}{25}=172.8\approx 173.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Write \(\angle B,\) \(\angle C,\) and \(\angle D\) in terms of \(\angle A\)
